verdict.rationale: Docs confirm image understanding is a first-class capability: models accept image input and 'consider the image context when generating the response' (grok-docs-25), plus related image editing docs show the model 'understands the image content' (grok-docs-29). No independent hands-on report specifically tests screenshot/photo interpretation accuracy. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of accuracy on real screenshots or photos, detail on multi-image or OCR-style interpretation limits.
